rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for making fabric from yarn or thread.

example.english: I know how to knit a sweater.

rows.note: Use this for people or things joining or ending up stuck closely together, especially in casual speech.

example.english: The MTR was so crowded that everyone ended up knit together.
example.traditional: 地鐵太迫，啲人黐埋一齊。
example.jyutping: dei6 tit3 taai3 bik1 di1 jan4 ci1 maai4 jat1 cai4

rows.note: Use this when assembling a whole from separate or mismatched pieces.

example.english: This machine was knit together from a pile of mismatched parts.
example.traditional: 呢部機係用一堆唔同嘅零件拼湊成嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 gei1 hai6 jung6 jat1 deoi1 m4 tung4 ge3 ling4 gin6 ping1 cau3 sing4 ge3

rows.note: Use this in medical or physical contexts when a broken bone or wound heals back together.

example.english: The broken bone has knit back together after treatment.
example.traditional: 骨折後，條骨經過治療已經癒合。
example.jyutping: gwat1 zit3 hau6 tiu4 gwat1 ging1 gwo3 zi6 liu4 ji5 ging1 jyu6 hap6
